claims.statement: 143 distinct deposited cell id labels; no explicit person-level donor ID or sample-level passage field in archived GEO sample characteristics.
claims.limitation: Cell-line labels alone do not prove 143 independent donors; absence in GEO is not absence from the study.

claims.statement: Nine samples expose cell line descriptions and library labels; no explicit person-level donor ID or sample-level passage characteristic in archived GEO Series Matrix.
claims.limitation: Generic descriptions and lab library labels cannot be compared to Coriell cell IDs as person identifiers.

claims.statement: Healthy-group fibroblasts came from Coriell's NIA/NIGMS cell repositories; HGPS fibroblasts came from the Progeria Research Foundation.
claims.limitation: Reported collection source does not establish an individual GSM-to-donor lineage record.

claims.statement: The publication reports healthy-group mean population doubling of 10 (SD 4.2), and HGPS-group mean passage number of 11 (SD 0.7).
claims.limitation: Population doubling and passage number are different metrics; aggregates must not be assigned to individual sample records.

claims.statement: The original publisher DOCX was downloaded and SHA-256 verified; document text mentions Tables S2 and S3. Individual GSM-to-table-row or culture-history mapping has not been extracted or certified.
claims.limitation: Structure/mention verification does not validate sample-level linkage, donor independence, or original table values.

claims.statement: The GSE307377 study describes four young and five older fibroblast donors obtained from the San Diego Nathan Shock Center Human Cell Models of Aging Core.
claims.limitation: No direct cross-study donor ID mapping or overlap exclusion has been established from the publication.

claims.statement: The NIGMS Coriell repository describes consent, privacy and material transfer conditions for physical human cell lines.
claims.limitation: Biomaterial distribution terms must not automatically be treated as a license or restriction on independent publicly posted GEO expression data.

review_gates.required: Verified pseudonymous person-level study-to-cell-line mapping with ethical handling
review_gates.review_question: Do original study or repository records provide permitted donor-to-cell-line mappings that verify independence without exposing identities?

review_gates.required: Documented controlled comparison of cohort donors or lineage provenance under appropriate authority
review_gates.review_question: Can the sources confirm whether the original Coriell/PRF lines intersect SD-NSC-derived donor lines, without attempting personal reidentification?

review_gates.required: Sample-level verified population-doubling or passage variable with exact GSM/cell-line linkage
review_gates.review_question: Can supplementary Tables S2/S3 be safely inspected and linked to publicly named cell lines, keeping doubling and passage distinct?

review_gates.required: Methods and supplementary table audit for GSE307377's nine lines
review_gates.review_question: Does the original study's Supplementary Table 1 include approved passage or lineage fields for these nine samples?

review_gates.required: Separate original GEO/public-data terms from Coriell MTA and institutional requirements
review_gates.review_question: Which restrictions apply to material samples versus already-deposited expression values, annotations and reproduced study tables?

review_gates.required: Platform, library prep, culture, passage, RNA extraction and processing audit
review_gates.review_question: Can a covariate-complete, appropriately balanced source-only design be specified before evaluating any expression-age relationship?

review_gates.required: Versioned annotation equivalence and a predeclared FPKM/TPM transformation policy
review_gates.review_question: Are shared RefSeq identifiers biologically comparable and what transformations would avoid treating FPKM as TPM?

review_gates.required: Independent written protocol review and leakage-aware pre-registration or clear exploratory labeling
review_gates.review_question: Is there a reviewed plan before fitting any age association or reporting an aging intervention?
